3.source_text: It will be but a few years, perhaps not to exceed fifty, that not a person here this day, will then be upon the earth. You will go into the world of spirits to try the realities of another state of existence. What we have to do, we must do in this state of existence, while in our tabernacles of flesh ; and if we make good use of our lives, and of our bodies, and of our talents, it will be well…
